name: @bigyellow12138/imagegen-mcp

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a new image or edit existing images through an OpenAI-compatible image relay. Use this whenever the user asks for a picture, illustration, poster, product shot, avatar, icon, concept art, or an image edit. Models: gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.6-flare, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst. Default: gpt-image-2.5-flare. Sizes: 1K/2K/4K are square presets (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096). To keep a portrait or landscape composition, pass an explicit WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1536x2048; when editing, omit size and the source image dimensions are reused automatically. Quality: low, medium, high, xhigh, max or auto. Pass local file paths in images[] for image-to-image editing. Editing is generative, not pixel-level: describe what to change AND what must stay the same, keep the instruction narrow, and prefer gpt-image-2.5-sunburst; the model may still alter unmentioned details. Images are saved to <project>/ai-images when the client starts this server inside a project, otherwise to ~/ai-images. When the user wants the image kept inside the current project or a specific folder, pass outputDir with the project path you know from your environment (for example <project>/assets). The absolute file path is returned in the text result.

prompt.description: Text description of the desired image. For edits: state the single change and what must stay unchanged (e.g. "replace the background with a snowy sunset, keep the person, pose and clothing identical"). Editing re-renders the image, so "do not change anything else" is a prompt instruction, not a guarantee.

model.description: Choose an exact model ID: gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2.6-flare, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst. Default: gpt-image-2.5-flare.

size.description: 1K/2K/4K are square presets (1024x1024 / 2048x2048 / 4096x4096). For portrait/landscape output pass WIDTHxHEIGHT such as 1536x2048 (multiples of 16). When editing and omitted, the source image dimensions are reused automatically. Default: 1K square.

quality.description: low is fastest, high is the default, xhigh/max give the most detail, auto lets the relay decide.

n.description: How many images to return (1-4). Default: 1.

images.description: Local image file paths for image-to-image editing. When provided the request uses the image edit endpoint.

outputDir.description: Optional directory to save images into. Use this to put images inside the current project, e.g. <project>/assets.

outputPath.description: Optional absolute file path for the first saved image.

instructions: 生图/改图工具：调用 generate_image。模型：gpt-image-2.5-flare / gpt-image-2.5-sunburst / gpt-image-2.6-flare / gpt-image-2.6-sunburst。默认：gpt-image-2.5-flare；可用 DEFAULT_MODEL 或 model 参数选择 2.6。尺寸：1K/2K/4K 是正方形预设；要保持竖图/横图比例就传 宽x高（如 1536x2048），改图时不传 size 会自动沿用原图尺寸。质量：low / medium / high / xhigh / max / auto。图生图或编辑：把本地图片路径放进 images 数组；编辑是重新生成而非像素级修改，提示词要写清楚“改什么”和“什么必须保持不变”，精细改图优先用 sunburst。默认保存到项目目录下的 ai-images（客户端在项目里启动时），否则保存到用户主目录下的 ai-images。如果用户希望图片放进当前项目，请把你已知的项目路径传给 outputDir（例如 <项目>/assets）。结果文本里会返回文件路径。
